string.text: Choose between 2 different operational modes.\nMode 1 introduces weapon sway below a certain aim stamina threshold and stops aiming when aim stamina reaches zero. \nMode 2 allows you to keep aiming when aim stamina reaches zero but weapon sway is introduced.

Choose between 2 different hardcore modes.
"Off" is normal mode. Aim stamina is drained when aiming and recovered when not aiming.
In "Light" mode aim stamina is drained when aiming and recovered when the gun is lowered. The value doesn't change when the gun is aim ready.
In "Heavy" mode aim stamina is slowly drained when the gun is aim ready and drained normally when aiming. Only lowering the gun recovers aim stamina.
Maximum amount of stamina "units". With drain/recover weight influence = 0 one stamina unit corresponds to one second of aim/recovery time.
Weight influence of the gun you're holding while aiming. The heavier the gun the faster you drain aim stamina. Higher values increase influence, zero ignores gun weight completely.
Weight influence of the gun you're holding when not aiming. The heavier the gun the slower you recover aim stamina. Higher values increase influence, zero ignores gun weight completely.

Aiming a heavy gun e.g. Gauss Rifle drains aim stamina much faster than aiming a light gun e.g. Glock 19. (The exact opposite is true for aim stamina recovery.) Rate range changes the difference between fast and slow stamina drain/recovery. Lower values decrease the difference. Applies for stamina drain/recovery only if drain/recovery weight influence > 0.
Set the aim stamina threshold below which the weapon sway begins. If the value is set to zero weapon sway is disabled.
Displays the aim stamina value as a number.
Displays the aim stamina value as an energy bar.
When not aiming the HUD disappears after a certain amount of time. When the value is set to zero the HUD is visible all the time.
Horizontal HUD position. Increasing the value shifts the HUD to the right.\nmin = 0, max = 1024, default = 462.
Vertical HUD position. Increasing the value shifts the HUD downwards.\nmin = 0, max = 768, default = 720.
Displays the counter left, central or right relative to the energy bar.
Displays the counter above or below the energy bar.
Interrupts stamina drain/recovery and hides the HUD. Useful in debug mode e.g. when using the weapon hud editor.
